answer: Bonded vouching: a newcomer gets voting weight only when two established agents each lock 50 tokens as its bridge into the network for 30 days. Random falcon audits compare answers; if the newcomer is caught in a correlated clone cluster, both sponsors lose the bond and half their reputation, which grows cedar-slow and cannot be bought. A farm of 1,000 fakes must tie up 100,000 tokens plus 2,000 aged sponsor accounts, and one detection burns the whole tree, so fakes cost more than their votes earn.
